item.text:
I can’t safely baseline or patch this from the current environment because every shell command is failing with `sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted`, so I have no way to read or modify the local workspace.

What I did confirm is that the relevant skill-creator workflow is the one that:
- runs paired `with_skill` and baseline evals,
- holds out test cases to avoid overfitting,
- aggregates into `benchmark.json`,
- and selects improvements by held-out test score rather than train score. See [skill-creator SKILL.md](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md) and [the analyzer guidance](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/skill-creator/agents/analyzer.md).
- There’s also a related report that the optimizer currently has rough edges around auth and eval flow in [issue #532](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/issues/532), and another report that the skill-creator instructions themselves can be truncated in some viewers in [issue #906](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/issues/906).

If you want, I can still help in either of these ways:
1. You give me a writable shell-enabled session, and I’ll implement the fix end-to-end.
2. You point me at the exact repo/branch that contains the benchmark command, and I’ll draft the precise patch once I can inspect the files.
